facts.text: The hotel occupies floors 102 to 118 of the International Commerce Centre in Kowloon.
facts.excerpt: This luxury hotel in Hong Kong, Kowloon occupies from 102/F - 118/F of the International Commerce Centre.

facts.text: The hotel sits atop the Elements shopping mall.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Hong Kong is conveniently located atop of Elements Shopping Mall

facts.text: All rooms and suites have unobstructed views of the harbour and city through expansive windows.
facts.excerpt: Perched on 490 meters above Victoria Harbour, all suites and rooms feature unobstructed views of Hong Kong's iconic harbour and cityscape through expansive windows.

facts.text: Tin Lung Heen serves refined Cantonese cuisine, traditional dim sum and premium tea.
facts.excerpt: Savor refined Cantonese cuisine, traditional Dim Sum, and premium tea at Tin Lung Heen.

facts.text: Tosca di Angelo serves Italian dining in a room with high ceilings, fountains and chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Experience elegant Italian Hong Kong hotel dining with high ceilings, fountains, chandeliers, and stunning views at Tosca di Angelo.

facts.text: Ozone is described as the highest hotel bar in the world, at 1,607 feet above sea level.
facts.excerpt: the highest hotel bar in the world at 1,607 feet above sea level

facts.text: Cafe 103 is named for its setting on the hotel's 103rd floor and is known for lunch and dinner buffets.
facts.excerpt: At Café 103, named for its setting on the hotel’s 103rd floor, the refined lounge is known for its lunch and dinner buffets featuring local specialties and international favorites.

facts.text: The spa is on the 116th floor and overlooks Victoria Harbour.
facts.excerpt: Located on the hotel’s 116th floor and overlooking Victoria Harbour, The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Hong Kong offers luxury and indulgence in a truly serene setting.

facts.text: On the 118th floor the hotel has an indoor infinity pool and a gym, both overlooking the harbour.
facts.excerpt: On the 118th floor, the hotel also has an indoor infinity pool and a spacious gym—both overlooking the harbor.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is on the 117th floor and is described as the highest hotel suite in the city.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is an ultimate expression of luxury, offering an unrivaled experience on the 117th floor - the highest hotel suite in the city.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: Ritz Kids Night Safari lets children set up camp in the family's room.
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids Night Safari brings the great outdoors inside by allowing your children to set up camp in your room.

facts.text: A Tea Experience, curated by the Tea Sommelier from Tin Lung Heen, offers a guided tasting of tea types, by reservation only.
facts.excerpt: Curated by our Tea Sommelier from Tin Lung Heen, the Tea Experience offers an introduction to the fundamentals of tea.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the area's general lack of walkability.
facts.excerpt: the area’s general lack of walkability

facts.text: The hotel is on top of the Airport Express Kowloon station, where guests can check bags before a flight.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is on top of the Airport Express Kowloon station, where you can check your bags before your flight.

facts.text: The minimum age for access to the spa and fitness center is 18.
facts.excerpt: The minimum age requirement for access to the spa and fitness center is 18.
